chore_rotation_members_exclusion_reason_.name: chore_rotation_members_exclusion_reason_check
chore_rotation_members_exclusion_reason_.value:
("chore_rotation_members"."eligible" and "chore_rotation_members"."exclusion_reason" is null)
				or (not "chore_rotation_members"."eligible" and char_length(btrim("chore_rotation_members"."exclusion_reason")) between 1 and 200)

chores_insert.name: chores_insert
chores_insert.withCheck:
app.is_household_parent("chores"."household_id")
				and "chores"."created_by" = (select app.current_user_id())
				and ("chores"."assigned_member_id" is null or app.is_member_id_in("chores"."household_id", "chores"."assigned_member_id"))

chores_due_label_check.name: chores_due_label_check
chores_due_label_check.value: "chores"."due_label" is null or char_length(btrim("chores"."due_label")) between 1 and 40

household_invites_insert.name: household_invites_insert
household_invites_insert.withCheck:
"household_invites"."invited_by" = (select app.current_user_id())
				and "household_invites"."accepted_at" is null
				and "household_invites"."accepted_member_id" is null
				and (app.is_household_owner("household_invites"."household_id")
					or (app.is_household_parent("household_invites"."household_id") and "household_invites"."role" = 'kid'))
